sentence: On /waterings, a failing GET /api/beds is ignored and the bed filter silently offers only 'All beds' with no error or retry.
evidence: Signed in as the demo user, then used Playwright to make GET /api/beds return 500 and clicked through to /waterings in the browser. The network log shows GET /api/waterings 200 and GET /api/beds 500 (twice). The page listed 2 waterings (Shade corner, North bed), but the Bed select had only one option, 'All beds'. The page showed no error alert and no retry control. The cause is in waterings.vue: `const { data: beds } = bedsResult` never reads bedsResult.error, and the select loops over `beds ?? []`. So the user cannot filter by bed and is not told why, which looks the same as having no beds. Other load failures in the app do show an AlertMessage.
